E0803

Calling a value that isn't a function

What

Calling a value that isn't a function

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0803

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0803: tests/ui/call_non_function.stderr.

Error [E0803]: this is Int (a whole number), not a function
  --> tests/ui/call_non_function.jet:4:15
    |
  4 |     result :: get_number().call(1)
    |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: only a function value can be called with `.call(…)`
 Fix: call a defined `fn` by name, or store a lambda in a binding before `.call(…)`
